headline: In Uzbekistan, the feasibility of Russia's $100 billion project to divert Siberian river flows has been assessed
summary: Uzbekistan's water minister compared the $100 billion project to move 5 billion cubic metres of Siberian water to Central Asia with local water-saving measures. He did not rule out revisiting river diversion.
why: Large cross-border water and infrastructure projects carry significant cost, financing and geopolitical implications for Central Asian and Russian economies.
original_headline: O‘zbekistonda Sibir daryolari oqimini burish bo‘yicha Rossiyaning 100 mlrd dollarlik loyihasi qanchalik maqsadga muvofiqligi baholandi
